description: Exact words said on earnings calls (full-text, verbatim): each hit has the speaker, a snippet and a link to the moment, plus the ticker and quarter key for get_transcript. Use it for 'what did the CEO say about X'. Only calls with a published transcript are searched (about 300 quarters); for themes across all companies, use search_earnings. Filler words are ignored; when every word together finds little, hits with any of the words are added.

query.description: Words or a question; filler words are ignored

ticker.description: Only this company: ticker or name
